map.：算法：椭球体积 V = 4/3·π·a·b·c（a,b,c 为三个半轴）。当: : Algorithm: ellipsoid volume V = 4/3·π·a·b·c (a,b,c are three semi-axes). Degenerates to sphere V=4/3·πr^3 when a=b=c=r. Requires a,b,c>0.
map.：例：a=3m、b=2m、c=1m → V=4/3·π·6=25.1327 m³: : Example: a=3m, b=2m, c=1m -> V=4/3·π·6=25.1327 m^3. If a=b=c=2m (sphere) -> V=4/3·π·8=33.5103 m^3, exactly matching the sphere formula.

map.扁椭球（地球形状）适用吗？: Does it apply to an oblate spheroid (Earth shape)?
map.适用，地球近似为 a≈b（赤道半径）略大于 c（极半径）的扁椭球；代入三半轴即得: Applicable; Earth approximates an oblate spheroid with a≈b (equatorial radius) slightly larger than c (polar radius); plug in three semi-axes for approximate volume; this formula does not distinguish prolate/oblate.
